subject: function:StringTextWidthSub
value: THE LAW. The emission ORDER of an inlined helper's copy-in temporaries is decided by whether each argument arrives as a call-site EXPRESSION or as a preceding ASSIGNMENT STATEMENT, and hoisting one argument into a statement emits its temporary FIRST -- but the named carrier that hoist requires is a word-class declaration, and adding one renumbers the whole callee-saved pile, so the lever is only a win where the pile can be held constant. This extends claim.law.CL_inline-helper-parameter-order-folds-away-before-codegen.20260903.v1 from that law's MASK argument to the POINTER argument of the same call, and it converts that law's 'expression PLACEMENT is live' boundary into a stated price. MEASURED 2026-09-03 on game/ui/btext::StringTextWidthSub at commit ca4074cb1, count-symmetric at T121/O121 throughout, baseline real 72 / 42 differing words / fresh objdiff fuzzy 91.8512%. The residual being attacked is a transposition present at BOTH inline expansions of the file-local helper TextLinesWidth: the target emits the line-buffer base before the colour mask (`9c: addi r23,r1,108` then `a0: clrlwi r28,r31,24` in the idx>=0 arm; `108: addi r25,r1,36` then `10c: clrlwi r31,r31,24` in the else arm) and our build emits them the other way round. Declaring `u8** lines;` and assigning `lines = (u8**)buf2;` before the call MOVED the base into the target's order at the first site -- ours then emitting `9c: addi r20,r1,108` then `a0: clrlwi r19,r31,24` -- and closed that cluster outright, taking `fndiff --ops` from seven clusters plus one aligned IMMEDIATE row to six clusters with the IMMEDIATE row gone. THE PRICE, measured three ways: block-scope carriers in both arms cost real 72 -> 94 with the pile shifting (nlines r24 -> r23, the helper's max r29 -> r28, the literal-zero web r25 -> r24, the base r23 -> r20); one function-scope carrier cost 72 -> 92; and holding the declaration COUNT constant by writing the carrier in place of the function's `u8 unused[4]` pad cost 72 -> 110, because that pad is load-bearing for the frame rather than nominal. Declaration POSITION of the carrier within the word class is inert: two different positions produced the identical score 92, which is the two-identical-A/Bs axis kill. The BOUNDARY, also measured: this is about statement-versus-expression, NOT about the argument's spelling -- retyping the helper's first parameter from `u8**` to `void**` and passing the arrays by decay instead of by cast left the instruction stream's cluster set bit-for-bit identical, so cast-versus-decay never reaches the decision. PROCEDURE. When an inlined call's copy-in temporaries are transposed against the target, hoist the one that should come FIRST into an assignment statement; then check the callee-saved correspondence with savedregs.py before reading the score, because the pile renumber will usually swamp the gain and the aligned view is the only instrument that shows the lever worked.
